integrators | Previous Slide | Overview | Benefits | Capabilities | Contact Us | Next Slide | Turn Every Customer Interaction into Revenue Growth | Attract and retain customers with automated customer communication and promotional solutions from Epicor Service CRM. These business dashboard and intuitive reporting tools help you learn about your customers and the jobs that move the profit needle, increasing your ARO. | Save time and money on outreach with world-class promotional and campaign materials | Increase customer loyalty and return rates with timely, automated communication | Gain insights into campaign performance, ROI, reputation management, customer behaviors, and more | “ [Epicor Service CRM] makes our lives so much easier by doing everything we need automatically. ” | Danny O’Quinn | Owner | Eagle Automotive & Air Conditioning | Benefits | Grow Your Presence and Reputation | Every day, millions of people start their search for a repair shop by going online. Epicor Service CRM offers a dynamic website and extensive reputation management tools designed to help you create and maintain a professional, welcoming online presence to attract new customers. | Build Trust and Loyalty | Show your customers how much you appreciate them and their business through timely communication: real-time texting tools, tailored emails, and branded postcards all add a personal touch. Easily share alerts, detailed estimates, images, and other information customers need to manage their vehicle service experience using your iPhone or Android device. Send appointment reminders, thank-you notes, and use the optional broadcast texting feature to announce promotional offers or extend holiday wishes that keep your business top of mind. | Get More ROI | Make smarter financial investment decisions with resources that help you understand your customers’ behavior and identify growth opportunities. With an exclusive OBD4 Business dashboard and optional Closed-Loop Marketing feature, you can measure the performance of virtually every dollar invested in marketing. Easily identify which campaigns, messages, and other marketing investments result in service appointments and stop funding those that don’t. | Run Your Shop from Anywhere | Know what’s happening at your shop and maintain control when you’re away. Access Service CRM from your smartphone, tablet, or laptop in real-time to connect with customers, manage the shop’s calendar, create and confirm appointments, and monitor critical customer engagement and marketing metrics on the go. | Capabilities | Reminders & Messages | Send mCal appointment reminders by text with automated day-of-appointment notifications. Add post-service “Thank you for your business” text messages, featuring prompts for ratings and reviews. | Mtexting | An easy-to-use interface allows you to send professional texts, photo and video messages, receive alerts when customers reply, and conduct targeted message searches. | Frequency Report | Actionable reporting on customer and vehicle frequency, related average repair order (ARO), and spending. | OBD4 Business Dashboard | KPI data tracking features customer response by email vs. postcard, new customers by type of outbound communication, and repair ticket rankings. | Marketing Campaigns and Materials | Comprehensive, time-saving marketing library featuring website guidelines, emails, print and digital mailer formats, and other templates featuring modern, highly appealing messages and graphics. | Enterprise Dashboard | A consolidated view of data from all connected systems, including ROI, KPIs, marketing data, customer behaviors, and more. | Access the full list of integrations here. | User-Friendly Communications Console | Mobile-friendly, responsive design customized to user preferences. | See Full List | Service CRM Frequently Asked Questions | How can shops communicate with customers? | There are multiple channels for communicating with customers that are enabled by the Service CRM solution: | A custom-branded website | Text and multimedia messaging | Email | Postcards | Additionally, shops are able to develop and distribute customized promotions and targeted customer incentives to help drive traffic. | Does the Service CRM solution offer website hosting? | Yes, building a site with the Service CRM solution includes the ability to create an original web address or connect to an existing address already owned by the shop. | Can shops use customized graphics? | Yes, and they are encouraged to use their own custom images to amplify their own brands, which will provide higher response rates. | How does the text messaging tool work? | MTexting allows shops to send text, photo, and/or video messages directly to customers’ mobile devices. Texts can be sent directly from the Service CRM system via a computer, tablet, or smartphone, eliminating the requirement for shops to send messages using a personal cell phone number. | Can shops offer appointment scheduling? | Yes, the Service CRM solution includes an appointment scheduling tool that can be integrated with the shop’s website. This tool also automates appointment reminders via email and text. | Does the Service CRM solution send out reminders? | Yes, several types of automated reminders can be sent to customers based on the vehicle manufacturer’s recommendations and driving habits: | Service reminders based on manufacturer settings | Shop recommendations as noted on the customer’s invoice | Inspection reminders (emissions, safety, and more) | Can customers access their service history? | Yes, the Service CRM solution includes a service history tool that can be integrated with the shop’s website and electronic communication tools. | How are customers prompted to provide business reviews? | After each visit, a customer receives a thank-you note via email and text that includes a link to one of several predetermined review websites, including Google and Yelp. | What kind of actionable reporting is available? | A full dashboard of reporting applications is included, with a number of reports that provide actionable data across a variety of metrics: | ROI | Customer and vehicle frequency | “Drifted away” customers (shows customers who have visited the shop at least three times over the past 18 months, but have not visited at all in the past six months) | Communications console (shows weekly automated communications and provides the ability to make quick edits) | Undeliverable mail and email | Are multi-shop dashboards available? | Yes, owners of multiple shops are able to access an enterprise dashboard. | Does Epicor offer customer support? | Yes, each Service CRM contract includes unlimited customer support during regular business hours | Request a Demo | See what Service CRM can do for your automotive service business.
